summary: Read and pinned Koons 2001 pp.193-194 and Oppy 1999 pp.379-381 for #365 and #409. Mapping to the #755 collapse core, as analyst judgment: Koons's point concerns the necessitating member, for causes and not for the reason relation; Oppy's concerns coverage, epistemically, and neither text treats van Inwagen's argument. A stronger reading of Oppy as denying coverage was rejected because the sentence reports what non-theists dispute. Koons 1997 was not read: the search on 2026-10-31 found no author-hosted copy. Van Inwagen 1983 stays a candidate waiting for a witness. Root-premise delta: none.
